originalTitle: 重磅！“AIGC 绘画-人物设计白皮书-第一辑”今日发布！
title: Big News! "AIGC Painting - Character Design White Paper - Volume 1" Released Today!
oneSentenceSummary: This article serves as a visual dictionary for AIGC character painting, systematically organizing Chinese and English terminology across three major categories: hairstyles, hair accessories, and clothing, accompanied by numerous example images to help users accurately describe character appearances.
summary: The article begins with the concept of "words failing to convey meaning," pointing out that in the AIGC era, precise language description is key to obtaining high-quality generated content. Based on the author's own learning needs, they have compiled a reference guide titled "AIGC Painting - Character Design White Paper." This first volume focuses on three fundamental elements of character design: hairstyles (including subcategories such as partings, bangs, ponytails, buns, length, texture, braids, and vintage styles), hair accessories (including subcategories such as hair clips, hair ties, headbands, bows, hairpins, jewelry, flowers, and stylized items), and clothing (covering modern basic garments, structural details, historical Chinese costumes, traditional attire from various countries, professional uniforms, sportswear, and formal/stage wear). Each subcategory lists precise Chinese-English terms paired with example images generated by GPT-Image-2. Essentially, this article is a practical reference manual for AIGC painting creators, aimed at helping users build a vocabulary of visual elements and improve the precision of their prompt writing.

mainPoints.point: Precise language description is the core ability to achieve high-quality output in the AIGC era.
mainPoints.explanation: The author believes that large models are essentially mappings of semantic spaces. Without rich and accurate language to describe, users cannot obtain high-quality outputs, which determines their efficiency and capability in the AIGC era.
